newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers higher on firm crude.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers higher on firm crude.

text.p: Singapore bunkers continued to rise on Wednesday over gains in crude values, traders said.
Prices have been rising in the past few days on the back of the firm fuel oil market and crude gains further boosted sentiment, traders said.
"Crude gains make many suppliers believe prices should go up further," said one major. But he added it would take one or two more days to see if the uptrend is firm.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $103-$105 per tonne and 180-cst at $109-$112. MDO and gas oil were quoted at $190-$195 and $202-$215 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3571)
